parts.name: Blade Handle Set (Left)
parts.Basic_description: This part consists of one blade and one handle of the scissors, made of stainless steel for the blade and plastic for the handle.
parts.Functional_description: It provides one cutting edge and one gripping handle, allowing the user to apply force for cutting materials.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central screw pivot relative to the other blade handle set to perform the cutting motion.

parts.name: Blade Handle Set (Right)
parts.Basic_description: This part includes the second blade and handle of the scissors, made of stainless steel and plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It forms the complementary cutting edge and handle, working together with the other blade handle set to cut materials.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around the screw joint, moving in opposition to the other blade handle set to create a shearing action.

parts.name: Screw
parts.Basic_description: A small steel screw that connects the two blade handle sets at the pivot point.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the two blade handle sets together and allows them to rotate smoothly around the pivot.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while allowing rotational movement of the two blade handle sets around it.
